svg.text: cursor: bytes read per file, or -1
stored in one transaction by the caller
first, the cursor that comes in is checked: a key that is not this launch's file,
or a value out of range, is dropped or reset and counted as bad_cursor
any other read error: read_error, retried next time · a file gone since the listing: skipped
